answer: The hollow schedule is applied in dune and cipher publishes each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 46% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2464 identities would post 1098 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
